column7: Projects the HTTP caller's key scope (client.backends) into the BackendGrant every MIK-8387 absence site judges a backend name by; the same list authorize_backend reads, so a mistake would hide or expose backend names to a scoped key
A task worker's backend grant: delegates to the creating request's authorizer; answering Unscoped instead would turn off the scoped absence checks on the worker path (MIK-8387 W1)
